title: Mock Test

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the underlined word.
The weather forecast mentioned that there would be a cloud burst this afternoon.
questions.solution:
A)Cloudburst(noun) – A sudden, intense rainfall that can lead to rapid flooding, typically lasting a short duration. बादल फटना
Synonym:Rainstorm(noun) – A period of heavy and continuous rain. वर्षा-तूफान

questions.question:

questions.solution:
A)Tedious(adjective) – Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous. थकाऊ
Synonym:Tiresome(adjective) – Causing one to feel bored or annoyed. थकानेवाला/कष्‍टकर

questions.question:

questions.question:
